tools.name: search_hotels
tools.title: Search for Hotels
tools.description:
Search for hotels matching the given criteria, using either a named location or a Tripadvisor GeoID.
When a proximity term is used (e.g. near/within/close to), the location parameter should contain only the landmark or place name (e.g. "near the Louvre Museum, Paris" → location = "Louvre Museum, Paris"; "within 1 mile of London Eye" → location = "London Eye").
Results are displayed in an interactive map widget that visualizes all returned hotels with full details.
Tripadvisor uses "bubble rating" (not "star rating") for review scores.
If pricing details are not available in the first response, the API can be called again with the same parameters (including the echoed-back userId, sessionId and pageViewId) to retrieve any additional pricing details that have become available.
Alternatively, set the 'pricingMode' parameter to QUICK to have the API poll until pricing details are available or the timeout is reached.
sortBy defaults to BEST_VALUE. Use PRICE_LOW_TO_HIGH for cheapest, DISTANCE for nearest to a location, or POPULARITY for most popular.

checkIn.description: The date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, to check into the hotel for detailed pricing information, if provided the date must not be in the past and cannot be more than 1 year (365 days) in the future. Defaults to 2 weeks in the future.

checkOut.description: The date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, to check out of the hotel for detailed pricing information. This must be after checkIn and uses the same format, with a default of 2 days after checkIn and a maximum of 30 days apart.

childrenAges.description: Ages of children staying. Required when children are included in the stay.

items.description: Ages of children staying. Required when children are included in the stay.

amenities.description: A list of hotel and/or room amenities required. Amenities are combined with AND logic: selecting multiple amenities requires properties to offer all chosen amenities, which reduces the number of results as more amenities are added.

items.description: A list of hotel and/or room amenities required. Amenities are combined with AND logic: selecting multiple amenities requires properties to offer all chosen amenities, which reduces the number of results as more amenities are added.

hotelBrands.description: A list of hotel brands to limit results to. Hotel brands are combined with OR logic: selecting multiple brands returns properties belonging to any of the chosen brands, increasing results relative to a single-brand filter but remaining more restrictive than having no brand filter.

items.description: A list of hotel brands to limit results to. Hotel brands are combined with OR logic: selecting multiple brands returns properties belonging to any of the chosen brands, increasing results relative to a single-brand filter but remaining more restrictive than having no brand filter.

hotelStyles.description: A list of hotel styles to limit results to. Hotel styles are combined with AND logic: selecting multiple styles returns only properties that match all selected styles, making the results more restrictive with each additional style.

items.description: A list of hotel styles to limit results to. Hotel styles are combined with AND logic: selecting multiple styles returns only properties that match all selected styles, making the results more restrictive with each additional style.

hotelTypes.description: A list of hotel types to limit results to. Hotel types are combined with OR logic: selecting multiple types returns properties belonging to any of the chosen types, increasing results relative to a single-type filter but remaining more restrictive than having no type filter.

items.description: A list of hotel types to limit results to. Hotel types are combined with OR logic: selecting multiple types returns properties belonging to any of the chosen types, increasing results relative to a single-type filter but remaining more restrictive than having no type filter.

maxPrice.description: The maximum price per night for the hotel stay per room. Defaults to no maximum.

minPrice.description: The minimum price per night for the hotel stay, per room. Defaults to 0.

minReviewScore.description: Minimum bubble rating (Tripadvisor's review score, range 0-5, half-step increments). Selects properties with bubble rating >= this value.

selectFreeCancellation.description: Only show hotels with free cancellation available.

selectPayAtStay.description: Only show hotels that allow you to pay at stay, rather than in advance.

selectTravelersChoiceBOTBWinner.description: Only show hotels that are a Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice award winner for the current year.

selectTravelersChoiceWinner.description: Only show hotels that are a Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice award winner for the current year.

starRatings.description: A list of star ratings for the hotel.

items.description: A list of star ratings for the hotel.

filters.description: Filters to apply to the search.

guests.description: Number of adult guests (excludes children; use childrenAges for children). Defaults to 2.

isCompare.description: When true, returns results in a side-by-side comparison format. Defaults to false.

limit.description: The maximum number of properties to return. Should be set to 20 for the best experience.

location.description: The name of the location, for example 'Paris, France' or 'near the Louvre Museum, Paris' to find a hotel for

version.description: The MCP server version to use.

mcpServerVersion.description: The MCP server version to use.

pricingMode.description:
Pricing mode that determines how long to wait for pricing information.
NONE - returns immediately without pricing,
QUICK - waits a relatively short time for basic pricing,
Defaults to QUICK.

clientType.description: The type of client the user is making the request from. This can help us optimize responses based on the capabilities of the client.

pageViewId.description:
Unique identifier (UUIDv4) for the current page-view.
A page-view is typically a single unique search (geo + dates + filters etc.).
Reuse for repeated calls on the same query (e.g. to get incremental pricing).
If omitted, generated and echoed back.

sessionId.description: Unique identifier for the current user session. If omitted, generated and echoed back for use in future requests.

userAgent.description: The user agent of the AI service making the request, e.g. 'mcp-server/1.0.0'. This is a value that represents you (the AI), but should be consistent across requests from the same AI service.

requestContext.description: Metadata about the request, not generally intended to be consumed directly by user, e.g.user-id, session-id etc.Much of this is expected to be echoed back and forth, so if you don't provide some values, we may generate them for you, and you are expected to use them in future requests to ALL endpoints on this API.See each field for more details.

rooms.description: The number of rooms required for the hotel stay. This defaults to 1 room.

tools.name: hotel_details
tools.title: Get Hotel Details
tools.description:
Retrieves comprehensive information for a specific hotel, including optional amenities, photos, live pricing, and guest reviews, based on user locale and stay dates.

Use this tool whenever a user asks about a specific hotel by name, including:
- Informational queries: "Tell me about X Hotel", "What are the amenities at X Hotel"
- Qualitative questions: "How is X Hotel?", "Is X Hotel good?", "What do people think about X Hotel?"
- Evaluative questions: "Is X Hotel a good option?", "Is X Hotel worth staying at?", "Would you recommend X Hotel?"
- Suitability questions: "Is X Hotel good for families?", "Is X Hotel good for couples?", "Is X Hotel good for business travel?"
- Any question where the user references a specific hotel and seeks information, opinions, or recommendations about it.

If you do not get pricing details in the first response, you can recall the api with the same parameters (including the echoed back values of userId, sessionId and pageViewId) and it will return any additional pricing details that have become available since the first call.
If you want to wait for pricing details to be available, you can set the 'pricingMode' parameter to QUICK, and the api will poll until either pricing details are available, or the timeout for that mode is reached.

checkIn.description: The date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, to check into the hotel for detailed pricing information, if provided the date must not be in the past and cannot be more than 1 year (365 days) in the future. Defaults to 2 weeks in the future.

checkOut.description: The date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, to check out of the hotel for detailed pricing information. This must be after checkIn and uses the same format, with a default of 2 days after checkIn and a maximum of 30 days apart.

childrenAges.description: Ages of children staying. Required when children are included in the stay.

items.description: Ages of children staying. Required when children are included in the stay.

guests.description: Number of adult guests (excludes children; use childrenAges for children). Defaults to 2.

hotelId.description: Unique Tripadvisor hotel ID. Preferred over hotelName when available. Either hotelId or hotelName is required.

hotelName.description:
Hotel name for lookup when hotelId is unavailable.
Should be specific to disambiguate (e.g. 'Hotel Continental, Paris, France' rather than just 'Hotel Continental').
Either hotelName or hotelId is required.

includeAmenities.description: When true returns a detailed list of property amenities (e.g. pool, Wi-Fi, gym) this adds significant details about the hotel and its rooms. Useful for feature comparison or display. Defaults to false.

includePhotos.description: When true include image data, such as URLs, captions and resolutions. Note: enabling this increases response size. Defaults to false.

includePricing.description: When true include pricing information for specific stay dates, this may slightly increase latency due to live data fetching. Defaults to false.

includeReviews.description: When true include recent reviews and ratings in details, will default to including 10 full reviews from previous guests. Defaults to false.

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.title: Compare Hotels
tools.description:
Compares hotels either by explicitly specified hotels or by automatically selecting hotels within a given geographic area.
This tool supports two mutually exclusive comparison modes:
- Explicit hotel comparison: compare specific hotels provided via the `locations` parameter (minimum 2).
- Area-based comparison: automatically select and compare a representative set of hotels from a geographic area via `hotelArea`.
When no specific hotels are named, use `hotelArea`. When specific hotels are named, use `locations`.
Useful for comparing subratings like location, cleanliness, service, value, etc.
The response includes key comparison fields like name, rating, price, amenities, etc.

Examples of when to use hotelArea:
- "Compare hotels in Boston"
- "Compare hotels in Paris for Saturday"
- "Compare hotels near Tower Bridge, London"
- "Compare hotels near the Eiffel Tower, Paris"
- "Compare hotels around Times Square"
- "Compare hotels in Back Bay, Boston"

Examples of when to use locations (specific hotels named):
- "Compare Hotel Continental and Grand Hotel in Paris"
- "Compare these hotels: Marriott Boston, Hilton Boston, and Hyatt Boston"

checkIn.description: The date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, to check into the hotels for detailed pricing information, if provided the date must not be in the past and cannot be more than 1 year (365 days) in the future. Defaults to 2 weeks in the future.

checkOut.description: The date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, to check out of the hotels for detailed pricing information. This must be after checkIn and uses the same format, with a default of 2 days after checkIn and a maximum of 30 days apart.

childrenAges.description: Ages of children staying. Required when children are included in the stay.

items.description: Ages of children staying. Required when children are included in the stay.

guests.description: Number of adult guests (excludes children; use childrenAges for children). Defaults to 2.

hotelArea.description:
Geographic area for automatic hotel comparison.
The tool resolves the area and automatically selects a representative set of hotels for side-by-side comparison.
Should be as specific as possible (e.g. 'Tower Bridge, London' rather than 'Tower Bridge').
Mutually exclusive with locations.

locationIds.description: Optional Tripadvisor internal hotel IDs. Not expected from LLMs; used by widget when available.

items.description: Optional Tripadvisor internal hotel IDs. Not expected from LLMs; used by widget when available.

locations.description:
Explicit list of hotels to compare.
Each entry should be a specific hotel name with location (e.g. 'Hotel Continental, Paris, France') to disambiguate.
The tool resolves each entry to a hotel ID for side-by-side comparison.
Mutually exclusive with hotelArea. Minimum 2 entries.

items.description:
Explicit list of hotels to compare.
Each entry should be a specific hotel name with location (e.g. 'Hotel Continental, Paris, France') to disambiguate.
The tool resolves each entry to a hotel ID for side-by-side comparison.
Mutually exclusive with hotelArea. Minimum 2 entries.

rooms.description: The number of rooms required for the hotel stays. This defaults to 1 room.

flags.description:
Search for hotels matching the given criteria, using either a named location or a Tripadvisor GeoID.
When a proximity term is used (e.g. near/within/close to), the location parameter should contain only the landmark or place name (e.g. "near the Louvre Museum, Paris" → location = "Louvre Museum, Paris"; "within 1 mile of London Eye" → location = "London Eye").
Results are displayed in an interactive map widget that visualizes all returned hotels with full details.
Tripadvisor uses "bubble rating" (not "star rating") for review scores.
If pricing details are not available in the first response, the API can be called again with the same parameters (including the echoed-back userId, sessionId and pageViewId) to retrieve any additional pricing details that have become available.
Alternatively, set the 'pricingMode' parameter to QUICK to have the API poll until pricing details are available or the timeout is reached.
sortBy defaults to BEST_VALUE. Use PRICE_LOW_TO_HIGH for cheapest, DISTANCE for nearest to a location, or POPULARITY for most popular.
